model: Builds are versioned per Windows version. The site serves the latest build; the installer device-matches — select-build.mjs picks the variant whose target range contains the device's Windows build number (an in-range match first, else the nearest variant at or below it, else no build claims the device). Adding support for a new Windows version is a new entry in this file plus that entry's installer surface; the daemon core does not change, because everything version-specific is declared here and in the installer, never in the daemon.

commandStructure: ScheduledTasks cmdlets in their Windows 10/11 form: New-ScheduledTaskAction, New-ScheduledTaskTrigger (-AtStartup / -AtLogOn), New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal (S4U / Interactive), New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet, Register-ScheduledTask -Force.
powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac and hibernate-timeout-ac for the designated-host (never sleep on AC) posture.

Identity dir under the user profile (%USERPROFILE%\.scripture-armor; %USERPROFILE%\.kingmaker\scripture-armor for the Kingmaker-bundled product). On this variant the transport's privacy rests on the profile ACL plus the pipe's default DACL — there is no POSIX mode model.
surface.daemonHost: Task Scheduler boot task (S4U principal, runs as the installing owner, restarts on failure). The task persists NO --socket argument; the daemon's own default (the transport helper) decides the endpoint, like every other caller.
hostOnlyChecks: Foreground vaultd run binds the pipe and answers status on both channels (WINDOWS-PROOF.md step 4)
Pipe DACL across the S4U boot-task principal -> interactive-user boundary
Boot persistence: task starts vaultd at boot, pre-login; LastTaskResult sane
SmartScreen first-run prompt on the unsigned .cmd files (expected friction, not a defect)
surface.transport: Named pipes, computed by scripture-armor/daemon-transport.mjs: \\.\pipe\scripture-armor-vaultd-<first 12 hex of sha256(normalized identity dir)>, owner endpoint the same name + '.owner'. Owner token/confirm FILES stay in <identityDir>\owner\. No filesystem socket path is computed anywhere in this variant.

targets.notes: Declared support floor: version 2004 (build 19041). The last Windows 10 feature build is 22H2 (19045); no Windows 10 build exists above it.
21H2 (22000) through 24H2 (26100) and later, until a future variant narrows this range by declaring its own.
